source_refs.note: Time of Flight: a main subheading of 2.6 Projectile motion, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 34-34.

blocks.text: Body phenkne ki jagah se le kar zameen se takrane ki jagah tak jo time leti hai, use time of flight kehte hain.

Ise nikalne ke liye S = h = 0 lete hain, kyun ke body oopar ja kar wapas usi level par aati hai, yani total vertical distance zero. Agar body velocity vi se horizontal ke saath angle θ par phenka jaye to us ka vertical component vi sin θ hai. To equation of motion yeh banti hai (oopar positive, is liye g negative):
Yeh zameen se phenki gayi projectile ka time of flight hai.
